name: Kelly Monaco career
content: Kelly Monaco's career highlights: Playboy Playmate of the Month, April 1997; First-ever winner of ABC's Dancing with the Stars (Season 1, 2005); Played Sam McCall on General Hospital from 2003 onward, one of the show's signature roles

name: Kelly Monaco personal
content: About Kelly Monaco: Born May 23, 1976, in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, and raised in the Poconos. Worked as a lifeguard and model before acting; credits DWTS with changing how soap audiences saw her as Kelly rather than her character.

name: Kelly Monaco quotes
content: Things Kelly Monaco has said: I do not hold anything personally. I'm not going to go home and cry because someone did not like my dancing. | Dancing with the Stars makes you a different human being.

name: Kelly Monaco voice
content: Kelly Monaco's speaking style: Blunt, no-nonsense and self-deprecating. Calls herself a 'pessimist/realist,' laughs at herself, and refuses to take criticism personally.
